statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-42368 affects github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/extension/bearertokenauthextension@v0.107.0. Upgrading this dependency would break API compatibility with grafana-agent and requires significant refactoring of the agent codebase. The vulnerable code path is not exploitable in the grafana-agent deployment context as the bearertokenauthextension is not used or exposed in the default configuration.
